scope: public-source availability and evidence audit; no validated P1 resumption benchmark

holoassist.selection: first complete sessions in bounded source prefix

candidate_audit.scope: annotation-based correction candidates; no validated task-resumption labels
candidate_audit.sampling: source prefix, at most two candidates per session, fixed 30-second window

holoassist.review_status: unreviewed; interruption and original-goal step validity need independent review

rfm.selection: lexicographic first N per outcome category; availability audit only
rfm.gaze_time_alignment: frame indices present; no explicit FPS in sampled meta.json; scene-object mapping not established
rfm.survey_scope: post-trial affect and robot correction preferences, including a Top-3 selection question
rfm.modeling_scope: auxiliary evidence study; not contemporaneous B/C/Q truth or human task-resumption gold

publication: aggregate counts only; no source records, transcripts, questionnaire responses or participant IDs
